Compatibility: Aquatic (or Reptilian*)

Ba Huagin are diminutive, four-armed huagin with more vivid colorations, larger, more emotive eyes, and whiskered tendrils on a lizard-shaped head.

There are many rumors as to why ba huagin are so diminutive and almost draconic compared to others of their kind. While sometimes thought to be the result of a literal marriage of a huagin and kobold, the belief most often held by the huagin themselves is that ba huagin are descendents of huagin who worshiped sea dragons. The influence of these dragons twisting them over centuries into a shape more befitting the service of a dragon before some apocryphal splintering that made these huagin their own masters once more.

Either case it implies an ancestral connection to kobolds that often leaves ba huagin looked down upon by their kind, forcing some to work that much harder for approval. Other ba huagin embrace it, identifying as equally kobold as they are huagin.

That said, debates about their origins don’t stop there. Some evidence points to ba huagin existing even before huagin, implying that huagin bred their desirable four-armed trait into their kind while breeding out perceived undesirable traits like smaller and weaker bodies, resulting in the much-respected saba huagin, whose name literally means “huagin of the sa and ba.” Though popular amongst ba huagin, this theory is rarely spoken about loudly by those without a death wish.

system.classDetails:
Ba Huagin Traits

  • Attribute Increase: Your Dexterity increases by 1.
  • Small Size: Your size is now Small. Your height decreases by about 1d4 feet, and your weight decreases by half of your core race’s weight.
  • Skill Proficiency: You have proficiency in the Intelligence (Arcana) skill.
  • Increased Swim Speed: Your swim speed is increased by 15 feet.
  • Sunlight Sensitivity: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.YQWX74CA8BA3ZKDG]{Sunlight Sensitivity}
  • Dry Skin: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.8UMKZTEWXL5TOHF4]{Dry Skin}
  • Extra Arms: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.YLHO6P1KHCUAL9OP]{Extra Arms}
  • Four-Handed: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.60SP46N54DDHRTIR]{Four-Handed}
  • Tri-Wield: @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.5YTUEHPZ18OHVJ18]{Tri-Wield}

Alternate Compatibility: This branch race can be mixed with a “reptilian” compatibility core race during character creation. If you do so, you also gain the following racial trait:

  • Reduced Swim Speed: Your swim speed is reduced by 15 feet.
